name: Hurricane Electric Free DNS
free_limit: Free authoritative forward and reverse DNS hosting with IPv4/IPv6 support, dynamic DNS updates, secondary/slave zones, and A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, CAA, SRV and other record types.
watch_out: Bring your own registered domain; reverse DNS delegation depends on the IP allocation holder. The provider labels this an open beta and does not publish a guaranteed DNS query quota or commercial SLA; account/card and commercial-use terms require confirmation.
